title: Bentness from the spectral maximum
statement: Let $n$ be an even natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube such that $|f(x)|=1$ at every input. If the maximum absolute value of its Fourier coefficients is $2^{-n/2}$, then every Fourier coefficient of $f$ has absolute value $2^{-n/2}$; in particular, $f$ is bent.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
$f$ has absolute value $1$ at every input
The spectral infinity norm of $f$ equals $2^{-n/2}$
